# unraid_array (Data Source)

State, capacity and disks of the Unraid array. Requires `READ_ANY` on `ARRAY`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "unraid_array" "this" {}

output "array_state" {
  value = data.unraid_array.this.state
}

output "failing_disks" {
  value = [for d in data.unraid_array.this.disks : d.name if d.status != "DISK_OK"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `boot_devices` (Attributes List) Boot devices (flash or internal boot). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--boot_devices))
- `caches` (Attributes List) Cache pool devices. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--caches))
- `disks` (Attributes List) Data disks. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--disks))
- `free_kb` (String) Free capacity in KB (string, as returned by the API).
- `id` (String) Array identifier.
- `parities` (Attributes List) Parity disks. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--parities))
- `state` (String) Array state, e.g. `STARTED` or `STOPPED`.
- `total_kb` (String) Total capacity in KB.
- `used_kb` (String) Used capacity in KB.

<a id="nestedatt--boot_devices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `boot_devices`

Read-Only:

- `device` (String) Device name, e.g. `sdb`.
- `fs_free_kb` (Number) File system free space in KB.
- `fs_size_kb` (Number) File system size in KB.
- `fs_type` (String) File system type.
- `fs_used_kb` (Number) File system used space in KB.
- `id` (String) Disk identifier.
- `idx` (Number) Slot number (parity 0/29, data 1-28, cache 30-53, flash 54).
- `is_spinning` (Boolean) Whether the disk is spinning.
- `name` (String) Slot name, e.g. `disk1`.
- `num_errors` (Number) Unrecoverable I/O errors.
- `rotational` (Boolean) `true` for HDD, `false` for SSD.
- `size_kb` (Number) Disk size in KB.
- `status` (String) Disk status, e.g. `DISK_OK`.
- `temp` (Number) Temperature in °C (null if unavailable).
- `type` (String) `DATA`, `PARITY`, `CACHE`, `BOOT` or `FLASH`.
